verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation, policy statement, or contractual language addressing whether customer data flowing through Fivetran is used to train AI/ML models, despite Fivetran having AI-adjacent features (AI support assistant, MCP server, 'unified context layer' for AI tools) that make this a fair privacy question for an AI-native buyer. Nothing in the docs or community evidence confirms or denies a training opt-out or no-training guarantee.
